name: gamenet_register_gameplay_handlers_and_callbacks
description: GameNet::RegisterGameplayHandlersAndOptCatalogCallbacks registers gameplay packet handlers and installs the GameNet/OptCatalog/zDEClient callback band.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent GameNet gameplay-registration source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja renders the final zEffect_Anim::SetActivationDispatchContext tailcall as a return expression even though the source-level contract is void.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x431c50 validates guarded registration of packet handlers 1, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0x0a-0x14 with mode 2, setting g_GameNet_HandlersRegistered, installing zDEClient crater/quicksand relay callbacks, OptCatalog allocation/no-op/remove-runtime callbacks, and zEffect_Anim activation dispatch context 0x0c.
The native GameNet registration smoke verifies handler count, packet type coverage, handler mode 2, duplicate-call suppression, callback globals, and zEffect activation dispatch context.
